name: Lying Chest Press Machine
how_to:
Setup

- Adjust the seat height so that the handles align with the mid-chest level when seated.
- Sit back with your spine firmly against the backrest and feet planted flat on the ground.
- Grip the handles with an overhand grip, ensuring your wrists remain straight.
Execution

- Starting Position
  - Hold the handles with your arms extended but elbows slightly bent to avoid locking out.
  - Engage your core and keep your shoulders down and back.
- Lowering Phase
  - Slowly bring the handles toward your chest, maintaining a controlled motion.
  - Stop when your elbows are at or slightly below chest level.
- Pressing Phase
  - Push the handles back to the starting position by extending your arms, squeezing your chest at the top of the movement.
- Repeat: Perform for the desired number of repetitions while maintaining control and proper form.
Tips for Maximum Effectiveness
- Focus on Muscle Contraction: Squeeze your chest at the top of the press to maximize muscle engagement.
- Control the Eccentric Phase: Lower the handles slowly to increase time under tension and promote muscle growth.
- Pair with Free Weights: Combine with exercises like the bench press or dumbbell fly for a well-rounded chest workout.
- Vary Grip Positions: Use different grips (narrow or wide) to target different areas of the chest.
- Breathe Properly: Exhale as you press the handles up and inhale as you lower them back.
